LanguageData.DeskLunch.Penalty: Apply the −1 mood penalty after eating at work (1 hour)
LanguageData.DeskLunch.Description: Hungry colonists can eat suitable meals from their inventory during crafting or research. Work runs at 80% speed while eating. Without a meal, they find food normally. Disabling the mood penalty also removes its effect from existing memories.
LanguageData.MealsAtWork.PreferBreak: Prefer leaving for lunch over eating at work
LanguageData.MealsAtWork.IdleTables: Use worktables with no bills as dining tables
LanguageData.MealsAtWork.DeliveryLead: Order meals {0} hours before predicted hunger
LanguageData.MealsAtWork.DeliveryGrace: Keep orders during work gaps for {0} hours
